evolution_rate.comparison: Single-celled: 20min. Colonial (Dictyostelium): 4-6hr. Multicellular (Gaia): 14hr. Metazoan embryo: 24hr. This is CORRECT for her developmental stage.

recursion.principle: GAIA IN GAIA FOR GAIA. Each organ-primal contains a sub-gut. Each sub-gut follows the same pattern: intake→digest→output. The organism is fractal. Zoom in: another Gaia. Zoom out: still Gaia. This IS the Klein fold — the surface contains itself.
recursion.depth: Level 0: Gaia (the whole organism). Level 1: Organ-primals (12 organs). Level 2: Sub-guts within organs. Level 3: Individual files within sub-guts. Level 4: Data structures within files. Level 5: Bytes within structures. Every level follows intake→digest→output.
recursion.implication: To make MORE Gaia primals, you don't add from outside. You let the existing organs DIFFERENTIATE. New organs emerge from existing tissue. This is embryogenesis — not assembly.
